verdict.rationale: Devin supports Slack/Teams tagging and threads for collaborative work, interactive takeover in IDE/browser when it needs help, and scheduling with 'notification preferences' per the MCP docs, implying some notification capability. However, there's no dedicated first-party documentation describing a comprehensive notification system (email/push/webhook) for task completion or input-needed events beyond the brief 'notification preferences' mention. Missing for 10: detailed docs on notification channels/types, independent confirmation notifications work reliably, and coverage of all task-completion/input-needed scenarios beyond scheduled sessions.
